about: kino's internal test set (docs/agent-first-plan.md §4.7): 24 fixed briefs, 6 per video type, plus kit-01 to kit-05 (A4): one-line promo briefs where the harness loads the brand kit into the project first. Brands are fictional. Only bundled fonts (Inter, Montserrat, Noto Serif) and no media files, so every run is reproducible offline. Direction briefs (direction: true, B1) test the brief interview instead of a finished video: the agent gets only the person's request, and the harness answers its questions with the brief's scripted replies (evals/direction.mjs). Board briefs (board: true, B4b) are direction briefs that go on to the storyboard stop: after the playback, a question (the board's open items) gets boardReply, the run ends at kino's board ask or a message that asks nothing, and it is scored on the board ask too (evals/board.mjs). Do not edit a brief after results are recorded against it; add a new id instead.

briefs.brief: Launch promo for Orbit, a shared team calendar. Headline: "Plan the week in one view". Show three features in order: shared calendars, smart scheduling, focus blocks. End on "Try Orbit free" and orbit.app.

Promo for Fernway, a slow-travel booking site. Open on "Travel slower. See more." Then three destination names appearing one by one: Lisbon, Kyoto, Oaxaca. Then "Stays of 7 nights or more, 20% off". End on "Book at fernway.com".

Product promo for the Voltline V2 e-bike. Beats: hook "Your commute, rewired"; three spec callouts (80 km range, 3-hour charge, 21 kg); price "$1,899" with emphasis; CTA "Ride it this weekend" and voltline.bike.

Promo for Kelp Bank's savings account. Headline "Your savings, actually growing". Show an interest rate "4.6% APY" counting up from 0.0. Two trust points: no monthly fees, FDIC insured. CTA "Open an account in 5 minutes".
Square promo for Maple & Co bakery's autumn menu. Title "Autumn is in the oven". Three items with prices: Pumpkin loaf $6, Apple galette $8, Chai bun $4. End on "Pre-order at mapleandco.com".

30-second promo for Tidal Labs' developer API. Problem beat: "Ocean data is scattered". Solution beat: "One API for tides, currents and swell". Show a three-line code-style snippet card. Proof beat: "Used by 1,200 teams". CTA "Get a free key at tidallabs.dev".

Vertical social clip for Orbit. Hook in the first second: "Stop double-booking." Then three quick tips as cards: color-code calendars, block focus time, share one link. End on "Orbit — free for small teams". Keep text clear of the bottom 20% (platform UI).

Vertical clip: "3 reasons to bike to work" — 1. Faster than traffic, 2. Free exercise, 3. Zero parking. Each reason gets a big number and a short line. End on the Voltline name. Hook text must appear by 0.5 s.

Vertical clip with a progress bar along the top: "Pack for a week in one bag" — five checklist items appear one at a time (3 shirts, 1 jacket, 2 trousers, a scarf, comfortable shoes), each ticking off. End on "More tips at fernway.com".
Vertical clip: a big number "$2,400" counts up, with the line "What a $200/month habit becomes in a year". Then "Start small with Kelp Bank". Keep everything inside the 9:16 safe zone.
Vertical recipe teaser: title "Chai bun in 4 steps"; steps appear as cards: mix, rest 1 hour, roll with spice butter, bake 22 min. End on "Full recipe in bio". Warm, calm pacing.

Vertical clip announcing a feature: hook "New: swell forecasts", then three caption-style lines synced roughly every 3 seconds ("7-day outlook", "1 km resolution", "Free tier included"), then CTA "tidallabs.dev".

Explainer: how a tide forms. Steps: the Moon pulls on the ocean; water bulges toward it; Earth rotates through the bulge; most coasts get two high tides a day. Use simple shapes (circle Earth, smaller Moon, an ellipse bulge) and one caption per step.
Explainer: compound interest. Show a bar chart growing over 5 years for $1,000 at 5% (1050, 1103, 1158, 1216, 1276). Label each bar. Then a takeaway line: "Time does the heavy lifting".
Explainer: how Orbit finds a meeting time. Three people rows with busy blocks across a week grid; the free overlap highlights; a meeting block drops into it with the caption "Found: Thursday 2 pm".

Explainer with a step list: "How to book a slow-travel stay" — 1 pick a region, 2 choose 7+ nights, 3 meet your host, 4 settle in. Connect the steps with drawn connector lines; highlight the current step as it is explained.
Explainer: e-bike range. A line chart draws battery percentage from 100 to 0 over 80 km, with markers at 20 km, 40 km and 60 km and their percentages (75, 50, 25). End on "Range shown at eco assist".

60-second explainer: why sourdough rises. Four chapters with titles: wild yeast, bacteria and acid, gas bubbles, oven spring. Each chapter has a simple diagram built from shapes and one sentence of text. Keep each sentence on screen long enough to read.
Logo sting for Orbit: a small circle orbits a larger ring once, then the wordmark "Orbit" types or reveals beside it. Settle and hold the final lockup for at least 1.5 s.
Logo sting for Voltline: a lightning-bolt path draws on, flashes once (no more than one flash), and the wordmark "VOLTLINE" slides in letter by letter. Hold the lockup at the end.
Square logo sting for Fernway: three leaf shapes grow from a stem point, then "Fernway" fades up in the serif display font with a slight rise. Calm and soft.
Logo sting for Kelp Bank: wavy vertical strokes rise like kelp, gather into a rounded square badge, and "Kelp Bank" appears below. End with a tagline "Banking that grows with you".
Vertical logo sting for Tidal Labs: a wave line sweeps across, the letters "TIDAL" rise from behind it with a stagger, then "LABS" appears smaller underneath.
Logo sting for Maple & Co: a maple-leaf star shape spins in and scales to rest, then "Maple & Co" and "Bakery since 1987" reveal in sequence. Warm, unhurried.
A 15 s launch promo for Orbit, a shared team calendar, ending on "Try Orbit free" and orbit.app.
A 15 s promo for Fernway, slow-travel stays of a week or more, ending on "Book at fernway.com".
A 15 s promo for the Voltline V2 e-bike with 80 km of range, ending on "Ride it this weekend" and voltline.bike.
A 15 s promo for Kelp Bank's no-fee savings account, ending on "Open an account in 5 minutes" and kelp.bank.
A 15 s promo for Tidal Labs' ocean data API, ending on "Start building" and tidal.dev.

30-second vertical clip for Tidal Labs' swell forecasts, cut to music. Use music.m4a as the soundtrack and time the scene changes and entrances to its beats. Show the voice-over in voiceover.srt as captions. Visual beats: hook "Five apps before dawn?", product "One swell forecast", two facts "7-day outlook" and "1 km resolution", CTA "tidallabs.dev".
